title: Ledgerline 4.2 Release Notes
key_sentences: Version 4.2 is a feature release that also changes how Ledgerline is configured.
Read this section before upgrading, because two of these changes require action on your part.
The upgrade takes about ten minutes for a ledger of one million postings.
Always take a full database backup before you begin.
Reports with more than 200 columns may be cut off in the PDF export.
Please report other problems through the support portal.

rows: TCP port on which the web interface listens.
Public address used in e-mail links and in exported documents.
Connection string for the PostgreSQL database.
Maximum number of open database connections.
Schedule of the currency revaluation job.
Number of days audit records are kept, about seven years.
Parallel workers used for PDF exports.

list_items.text: Bank feeds can now be reconciled in bulk, with suggested matches ranked by confidence.
Multi-currency revaluation runs as a scheduled job instead of only at month end.
The audit trail records the client address and the API token used for every change.
PDF exports of reports are about three times faster on large ledgers.
1. The configuration file is now YAML; the old INI format is no longer read.
2. PostgreSQL 13 is the minimum supported database version.
3. The /api/v1 endpoints have been removed; use /api/v2 instead.
Back up the database and the existing configuration file.
Use pg_dump with the custom format.
Copy ledgerline.ini to a safe place.
Convert the configuration file to YAML, as in the example below.
Install the new package and run the database migration.
Start the service and check the log for the line “Ledgerline ready”.

code:
server:
  port: 8080
  base_url: https://ledger.example.org
database:
  url: postgresql://ledgerline@db01/ledger
  pool_size: 20
jobs:
  revaluation: "0 2 * * *"
audit:
  retain_days: 2555
exports:
  workers: 4

sudo systemctl stop ledgerline
pg_dump -Fc -f ledger-4.1.dump ledger
sudo dpkg -i ledgerline_4.2.0_amd64.deb
sudo -u ledgerline ledgerline migrate --to 4.2
sudo systemctl start ledgerline
